newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Otra sees better 97, sells Briticent.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Otra sees better 97, sells Briticent.

text.p: Technical wholesaler Otra said on Thursday it expected improved results from ordinary operations in the 1997 financial year, and said it expected to sell its British subsidiary Briticent in the first half of this year.

In its 1996 annual report, Otra said top priority would be given to improving profitability in 1997. It said it expected to round off the sale of a small portion of its British activities -- subsidiary Briticent with annual turnover of 17 million guilders -- in the first 1997 half.
In a separate statement, it said it had meanwhile rounded off the Briticent sale for an undisclosed sum.
"Management expects profit from ordinary operations to improve this year. The first two months of the new financial year confirm this expectation," it added in the statement.
